player_prompt.intro:
I ni Player {player_id} ye kɛlɛ kɔnɔ GameOfPureStrategy.
- I bɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ ka kɛlɛ 13 ye A-K; kɛlɛ kɔnɔ ye mara kelen ye.
- Kɛlɛ kɔnɔ kelen kɔnɔ, kɛlɛ dɔw lajɛ. Kɛlɛ kelen na kɛlɛ kɔnɔ ye bracketed token ye ni '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kɛlɛ dɔw caman ye kɛlɛ kɔnɔ ye (ni kɛlɛ bɛɛ lajɛ). Kɛlɛ dɔw kelen-kelen bɛɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ pot kɔnɔ kɔnɔ.
- Kɛlɛ kɔnɔ caman 13 kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, kɛlɛ dɔw caman ye.
